facts.content: Order labs including TSH, free T4, CBC, CMP, ferritin/iron studies, B12/folate, fasting glucose/HbA1c, lipid panel, consider Vitamin D, and possibly morning total testosterone if decreased libido persists.

facts.content: For mental health, screen with PHQ-9/GAD-7, discuss sleep hygiene, consider brief counseling, and ensure safety net for suicidal ideation with urgencies directed to ED if emergent.

facts.content: Reassess adherence to thyroxine and adjust according to lab results.

facts.content: Assess baseline SpO2, consider CXR and ECG if indicated, assess exercise tolerance, and consider peak flow if asthma is suspected.
